Summary: Storage All-hands - March
How to Participate:

,**UPDATE I have reserved rooms in Bel and MPK for those of you in the office to watch together**

This session will be completely virtual and broadcasted via. Livestream to Storage Core.

(Important: Please be sure to restart your VPN connection prior to joining the livestream. This will help ensure a seamless audio/visual experience.)

How to Submit a Question for the Q&A

,*Pre-Event *

To submit your question in advance, please add it to the poll in Storage Core

We will ask the top voted questions from the poll and then take questions during the live stream.

,*During Event *

Once the Q&A kicks off, you can ask your question by posting it directly within the comments section on the live stream. We will do our best to answer as many of these in real-time as possible.

Video Replay

If you are unable us to join us live, a video of the Q&A will be accessible for later viewing/playback within Storage Core.

Summary: Blair  Mickey - In Home Consultation for Tuesday 03/08 at 2.30pm - please confirm by Friday 03/04
Hello Blair,


My name is Monika Fronczak; I am the Senior Designer and Trade Specialist assigned to help you with your project.

Before we meet in Person I would like to outlined our process. I am hoping this way I will be able to clarify a few things prior to our meeting.

      What to expect from your FREE consultation:


•       The overall goal for in home consultation is to provide the designs and estimate for two standard closets. If the project consists of more than two spaces or if the discussed spaces are other than the closets – please let me know. We will review your project and decide what is the most important for you and what are the next steps.
•       We will discuss different finishes, styles, budget, and timeline for project execution. We recommend you visit one of our showrooms located through Bay Area: San Francisco, Burlingame, Mill Valley to get familiar with our product. Otherwise please follow the links:

o       Please use the following links as these will help you in assessing:
•       How to design with the budget: https://www.californiaclosets.com/design-to-your-budget/
•       What type of finishes we can offer: https://www.californiaclosets.com/finishes/
•       What kind of product we can offer:  https://www.californiaclosets.com/sustainability/

•       The Goal of your Free consultation is to provide you the estimate and ideas for your project based on the space measurements, discussed needs, finishes and budget; the projects consisting of two stamdard closets may be presented during the Consultation; if we run out of time – the designs will be shown via Zoom.
•       We are asking our clients to disclose all obstacles that are osbtructed to designer view (by pile of clothes, boxes, toys, etc).


What to expect after your FREE consultation:


•       For the projects reviewing the two standard closets client may expect that during this free consultation, they will receive the estimate and visual presentation.
•       For more complex proejcts – the designs will be presented via Zoom. It may take up to 7 business days to finalzie the designs.

      Next steps:

•       If the Designs are presented and Client wishes to work more and make additional changes – we are processing the Designer Retainer toward further work with the Designer.
•       The Designer Retainer can be used toward the Contract if Clients agree to move forward with the project (after one calendar year the Designer Retainer is forfeit if not used toward the project).
•       The Designer Retainer is not refundable if client decides not to proceed with California Closets.


      I hope that this outlined process helps and answers any questions you may have.

      If for some reason you need to reschedule — I kindly ask that you notify me at least 24 business hours prior to our meeting.  Please feel free to use the text number  415.766.7379


      Best regards,

Monika Fronczak
Senior Designer / Trade Specialist

Summary: Storage All-hands and Q&A
How to Participate:

,**UPDATE we have reserved rooms for those of you in the office to watch together**

This session will be completely virtual and broadcasted via. Livestream to Storage Core.

(Important: Please be sure to restart your VPN connection prior to joining the livestream. This will help ensure a seamless audio/visual experience.)

How to Submit a Question for the Q&A

,*Pre-Event *

To submit your question in advance, please add it to the poll in Storage Core

We will ask the top voted questions from the poll and then take questions during the live stream.

,*During Event *

Once the Q&A kicks off, you can ask your question by posting it directly within the comments section on the live stream. We will do our best to answer as many of these in real-time as possible.

Video Replay

If you are unable us to join us live, a video of the Q&A will be accessible for later viewing/playback within Storage Core.

Summary: Storage All-hands and Q&A
How to Participate:

,**UPDATE I have reserved rooms for those of you in the office to watch together**

This session will be completely virtual and broadcasted via. Livestream to Storage Core.

(Important: Please be sure to restart your VPN connection prior to joining the livestream. This will help ensure a seamless audio/visual experience.)

How to Submit a Question for the Q&A

,*Pre-Event *

To submit your question in advance, please add it to the poll in Storage Core

We will ask the top voted questions from the poll and then take questions during the live stream.

,*During Event *

Once the Q&A kicks off, you can ask your question by posting it directly within the comments section on the live stream. We will do our best to answer as many of these in real-time as possible.

Video Replay

If you are unable us to join us live, a video of the Q&A will be accessible for later viewing/playback within Storage Core.

Attendees: ... Many

Summary: Tech Talk: Cold Storage Capacity Explained
Cold Storage Tech Talk Series

This is a completely optional event for those that are interested in learning more about Cold Storage.

Bring your lunch, we will start around 12:15PM to give you time to grab some food.

As I ramp down on ABE, I'll be performing these tech talks around Cold Storage related topics to help off-board some of my knowledge, and help onboard new members. Feel free to join if you're and want to learn more about cold Storage!

Topics I plan to cover for Cold Storage:

  *   Cold Storage Architecture How well do you know these 12 services? Which are bachelors, and which have tied the knot?Actual - HDD services, how data moves onto T7 HDD disk s, and how we maintain our data.
  *   Disk Health Lifecycle Disks gone wild, an inside look at disks exposed, and what happens when they can't stay rowdy enough.Actual - How do disks change states and trigger repairs.
  *   Capacity Explained Is capacity even real, or just a figment of our imagination? 1 in every 1 professional thinks capacity is a myth sold by big Corpa.Actual - What HDD capacity is, how we categorize it, and how we handle new & expired drives.

Summary: ABE Tape Oncall Review
!! If you were oncall in the last shift, fill out your Shift Summary before the review.

Please use the Hands Tool to ask questions: <https://www.internalfb.com/intern/hands?id=95647027658> https://www.internalfb.com/intern/hands?id=95647027658

Each week we will come together to review the previous 2 oncall shifts. We will treat this like a less formal SEV review using the Oncall Shift Summaries:

  *   We will give everyone 3-5 minutes to read both shift summaries.
  *   The rest of the time is for everyone to ask questions, review the actions, and discuss follow-ups
  *   Tag oncall follow action items with:

#abe-oncall-followup

We will end the meeting early when there are no more topics to be discussed.

Oncall Resources:

  *   Oncall Wiki<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/wiki/Archival/Pods/Archival_Backend_Pod/Oncall/>
  *   Shift Summaries<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/monitor/shift_summary_v2?oncall=archival_back_end>
  *   ABE Oncall Health Dashboard<https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Ffburl.com%2Funidash%2Fgcr75y76&h=AT3Ie8KtqnqupNic-1xxg1EVR2V3LKt91fBrFDqPpE0a-QNiohl0SWlIfjU0ERzid6xXHumOh6zOSTHcCwDujlTws6I4eemO6vEu5u9JEzj9oSHP2TWvfhatvv0xQSj6DA8PMoPT>

,**UPDATE I have reserved rooms in Bel and MPK for those of you in the office to watch together**

(Important: Please be sure to restart your VPN connection prior to joining the livestream. This will help ensure a seamless audio/visual experience.)

How to Submit a Question for the Q&A

,*Pre-Event *

To submit your question in advance, please add it to the poll in Storage Core

We will ask the top voted questions from the poll and then take questions during the live stream.

,*During Event *

Once the Q&A kicks off, you can ask your question by posting it directly within the comments section on the live stream. We will do our best to answer as many of these in real-time as possible.

Video Replay

If you are unable us to join us live, a video of the Q&A will be accessible for later viewing/playback within Storage Core.

Summary: Discuss Timelines for BTW Promises
The goal of this meeting is to come up with a realistic timeline for BTW production criteria and communicate that with the customer.

Here<https://fb.workplace.com/groups/899478360482324/permalink/1383903622039793/> is the list of production criteria for BTW. The ones we are not supporting today include:

  *   100% scale for MySql
  *   Supporting multi-label (roughly 20 labels for MySql)

We also have to return their two clusters sooner rather than later. They allowed us to use them up to end of Q3 but they are also hit by capacity crunch and have some of their projects blocked due to lack of WS capacity.

Summary: {Jun 17, 2022} US Main SEV Review
Hello, you are invited to SEV Review to discuss the following SEVs

Agenda - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/review/585601075813189/

SEV2 S271054: Lost all connectivity to PSWs in FCO2 - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/view/s/271054/
Presenter: Emanuele Fia
Champion: Obi Okoye-Eze
Required attendees: Nathan Hu, Ciaran Walsh
Other attendees: Mike Ponomarenko, John Christino, Rohan Kapadia, Sarath Kumar A, Uma Rao, Neeraj Bahl, Mark McKillop, Jose Leitao, Giuseppe Rizzelli, Faruk Yilmaz

SEV1 S266070: Secure Notifications" failing across products (Account Recovery, 2FA, ...) by sending LS-NONCE instead of actual Nonce - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/view/s/266070/
Presenter: Jacob Unna
Champion: João Miguel Marçal Ramos
Required attendees:
Other attendees: Tom Tang, Krishna Gorantla, Darren Hwang, Gustavo Suarez, Nikola Vilimonovic

SEV1 S273652: Old data loss undetected in Manifold - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/view/s/273652/
Presenter: Samuel Kelly
Champion: Elle Lin
Required attendees:
Other attendees: Shival Maharaj, Norm Morrison, Piyush Mukati, Kishore Kankipati, Elle Lin, Jeffrey Mickey

SEV2 S271329: Hack SRClient wrong API usage caused CATs not be included in request headers - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/view/s/271329/
Presenter: Rahul Tekawade
Champion: Tarun Jaiswal
Required attendees: Garo Taft, Yueting Lee, Hamid Dadkhah, Eden Zik
Other attendees: Jin Hou, Cullen Walsh, Ezequiel Gomez, Yueting Lee, Gordon Huang, Suresh Pasala, Hamid Dadkhah, Asaf Azar, Jin Hou, Doug Neal, Peter Ruibal, Rahul Tekawade

Details

  *   Zoom ID with passcode for MSR
  *   <https://fb.zoom.us/j/760201844> https://fb.zoom.us/j/760201844
  *   Meeting ID: 760 201 844
  *   Password: 089271
  *   Remote SEV review etiquette post: <https://fb.workplace.com/groups/sevreview/permalink/3424430447605546/> https://fb.workplace.com/groups/sevreview/permalink/3424430447605546/
  *   Discussion group: <https://fb.workplace.com/groups/2505863742998491> https://fb.workplace.com/groups/2505863742998491

HOW TO PREPARE FOR SEV REVIEW: <https://fburl.com/sevreviewprep> https://fburl.com/sevreviewprep

---

COMMON QUESTIONS WE ASK & ADDRESS DURING SEV REVIEW

  *   How many people were affected and have we done everything we can to recover from this specific issue?
  *   Was the recovery completed sufficiently? Did we have the right logging to recover from this? If not, do we now have that logging in place?
  *   Is there a systematic fix we can do to prevent similar issues?
  *   Are the APIs/Interfaces/Alarms/Dashboards clear?
  *   Is the underlying data model robust?
  *   Were there any errors/warnings/failures that were ignored?
  *   Is this part of a bigger theme that needs to get addressed?
  *   Do we have tests in place for this? (If so, why did we not catch it earlier)
  *   Was the detection->fix process smooth & efficient?

If you have scheduling constraints or requests, please let me know ASAP. Do not forward this invite, email annettethomas@fb.com to include others on the invite.

Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns.

Thank you,
Annette Thomas

Summary: Storage All-Hands & Q&A
How to Participate:

This session will be completely virtual and broadcasted via Livestream to Storage Core.

(Important: Please be sure to restart your VPN connection prior to joining the livestream. This will help ensure a seamless audio/visual experience.)

How to Submit a Question for the Q&A

,*Pre-Event *

To submit your question in advance, please add it to the poll in Storage Core

We will ask the top voted questions from the poll and then take questions during the live stream.

,*During Event *

Once the Q&A kicks off, you can ask your question by posting it directly within the comments section on the live stream. We will do our best to answer as many of these in real-time as possible.

Video Replay

If you are unable us to join us live, a video of the Q&A will be accessible for later viewing/playback within Storage Core.

Summary: Tech Talk: Cold Storage Architecture Overview
Cold Storage Tech Talk Series

This is a completely optional event for those that are interested in learning more about Cold Storage.

Welcome to the first in-person tech talks in 2 years! Bring your lunch, we will start around 12:15PM to give you time to grab some food.

As I ramp down on ABE, I'll be performing these tech talks around Cold Storage related topics to help off-board some of my knowledge, and help onboard new members. Feel free to join if you're and want to learn more about cold Storage!

Topics I plan to cover for Cold Storage:

  *   Cold Storage Architecture How well do you know these 12 services? Which are bachelors, and which have tied the knot?Actual - HDD services, how data moves onto T7 HDD disk s, and how we maintain our data.
  *   Disk Health Lifecycle Disks gone wild, an inside look at disks exposed, and what happens when they can't stay rowdy enough.Actual - How do disks change states and trigger repairs.
  *   Capacity Explained Is capacity even real, or just a figment of our imagination? 1 in every 1 professional thinks capacity is a myth sold by big Corpa. Actual - What HDD capacity is, how we categorize it, and how we handle new & expired drives.

________________________________

Hi Team, we have an update coming up on Cold Storage Builds to IDC leads in 2 weeks, we need to reconcile the CS builds current GRD design specs and constraints. We also need this for the CS Strategy workstream update. I'm scheduling this meeting for us to review together and align on the following:

Matt - Can you please help share below items based on GRD / design

James- Can you please help share the uptime / resiliency assumptions or add if someone from FacOps can help support

  *   Layout with spindle/tape mix assumptions and flex options
  *   Electric / power design
  *   Mechanical / Cooling design
  *   Network design and constraints
  *   Maintenance / Uptime assumptions (FacOps)

Couple of the common questions / scenario we need to consider

  *   Can we make Cold Storage builds bigger going from 2 DHs to 3 or 4 DHs)?
  *   Can we flex tape to 100% or what is the max and infrastructure implications
  *   What is the uptime / resiliency of our infrastructure data centers (FacOps)

They include washing hands/using hand sanitizer and cleaning all surfaces with disinfecting wipes before and after every visit. </p> <p> But also know that once we get started you don’t even have to be present. We can call and let you know when we’re finished and you’re ready to use your new dream space. </p> <p> <em> To further ensure the safety of our employees, please contact us immediately if anyone in your home has a cough, cold, fever, or flu-like symptoms, and we’ll happily reschedule your installation. </em> </p> <p>To ensure that the installation process goes as smoothly as possible, please follow these instructions:</p> <ul> <li> <strong>Remove all personal items:</strong> Before work can begin, the installation area needs to be clear of all personal items so that our team can work efficiently. <br><br></li> <li> <strong>Clear the work area:</strong> For safety reasons, we request that you keep children and pets out of the work area during the installation.<br><br></li> <li> <strong>Designate an entrance close to the driveway:</strong> Please allow our installation technicians to enter your home through the entrance that is nearest the driveway so they can easily unload their materials and tools.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li> <strong>If your home was built prior to 1978: </strong>If the breakout of your existing system has not been completed prior to our arrival, our installers will not be able to remove your existing material due to EPA lead paint regulations. Summary: SEV/Oncall Followup Prioritization
We'll take a look at the triaged SEV and oncall followups here: https://fburl.com/tasks/q414r6p4

Goal will be to create a strict ordering by some field... I picked start date and initialized it to 6/1 for high priority, 6/15 for medium, and 6/30 for low and unprioritized.

We should prioritize work that has urgency and/or high impact per effort for consideration in Q3.

We'll do this as quickly as we can by looking at each item's size and briefly talking about its value. We'll reset priority and "start date" so that at the end we have a sortable list of work to focus on. A half hour won't be enough time - but hopefully we'll settle on the top ~10.

Summary: Next steps for Archival Security
Moving this to next week to accommodate a few folks.

Hey folks,

I want us to get together and identify how we should be thinking about next steps for Archival Security. Few questions to kick this off with.

1. What is the current security state for Archival? Are we meeting baseline expectations (for some definition) or are we not?

2. We are the next set of challenges we have to undertake towards improving Archival security? What is our strategy on Encryption@Rest for T7 or Archival overall?

3. How do we see SSC evolving?

Thanks

-Karthik

Summary: Archival HDD Wheel of Misfortune
Weekly meeting to run through a staged investigation as a group. Goals are to

  1.  Spread knowledge across the team
  2.  Spot followup items without waiting for an actual incident

Summary: Performance Summary Cycle (PSC) Kickoff - H2 2021 
The H2 2021 Performance Summary Cycle (PSC) kicks off January 4. See below for additional details, resources, and where to go for support.

During the feedback-writing period (Jan 4-13):

  *   Talk with your manager to identify 3-4 people to request feedback from in the Performance tool<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/performance/>
  *   If you won’t be working when PSC kicks off (e.g., LOA, PTO), you can request peer feedback early or your manager can request it on your behalf from the Feedback tab<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/performance/feedback/>> Team Summary > Manage Feedback.
  *   You will receive feedback request notifications by email; decline early if you don't have enough context.
  *   If you had more than one manager during the half, submit feedback for the manager who managed you the longest. You can choose to submit feedback for another if they managed you for at least two weeks during the half.
  *   Write all self, peer, and upward feedback by 5pm PT on Jan 13. After that, feedback can still be submitted but will have a late stamp, and the feedback may not be viewed in time for their manager to consider as they prepare for calibrations.
  *   You can reopen feedback until the deadline if you need to make any edits by going to your Home page > Feedback section > Feedback to Write > Submitted > Reopen.

Learn More

  *   Tips and examples for PSC feedback<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/people/portal/career/psc/psc-feedback-tips-and-examples>
  *   Details on each step of PSC<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/people/portal/career/psc>
  *   PSC Participation<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/people/portal/career/psc/psc-participation-eligibility>
  *   Note: People who are receiving an LOA rating will be sent an email by Jan 6. If you do not receive an email, but believe you had 70 or more business days of leave during the half, reach out to
  *   What it means to be a loop owner and how to

Get Support

There are several ways to get help and provide feedback. See below for what’s right for your scenario.

  *   Performance tool support: Fill out this form<https://fburl.com/psc-bugnub> for a bug report (e.g., UI/Content, broken functionality, you’re not seeing something
  *   Ask the People Team: If you can’t find your answer on the People Portal<https://our.internmc.facebook.com/intern/people/portal/career/psc> or the top FAQs<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/people/portal/help/case-intake/performance/psc>, you can open a case here<https://fburl.com/open-case> for support.
  *   Performance Feedback (PSC Tool & Cycle) group: If you’re still stuck, you can ask your question here<https://fb.workplace.com/groups/PerformanceFeedback/?epa=SEARCH_BOX>. Write feedback about the program or Performance tool this form<https://www.internalfb.com/butterfly/form/226176915672341>, or vote Papercuts<https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Ffburl.com%2Fpapercuts%2F5mkj4h6g&h=AT1A0kZQxbY6wcxDh8CHgMev7Kj_OtnsIryTl9E6Dkt-cVvb37pJXor9SFpLmsoUi4-bE3YkA9pc3VUdoYB8em_y_cgpRFu62CBJziNW6SbCgQ1N3US_1hTkmIq7Yifkm2baEtc>.

Please note that Short-term employees (STEs), interns and contingent workers are not eligible for PSC. See more here<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/people/portal/career/psc/psc-participation-eligibility> .

Summary: {Jun 03, 2022} US Main SEV Review
Hello, you are invited to SEV Review to discuss the following SEVs

Agenda - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/review/709490340177337/

SEV1 S271133: Loss of capacity due to Re-enabling Machinechecker Sensors Coverage - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/view/s/271133/
Presenter: Aleksander Książek
Champion: Eduardo Coutinho
Required attendees: Aleksei Astakhov, Elina Lobanova, Olivier Raginel
Other attendees: Gabriel Yllescas, Nick Shorter, Petar Vasic

SEV1 S264092: MySQL data not wiped properly - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/view/s/264092/
Presenter: Andrei Raduta
Champion: Catherine Sweeney
Required attendees: Patrick Pelletier, Tobias Asplund
Other attendees: Dmitrii Potoskuev, Catherine Sweeney, Owen Mooney, Tobias Fleig, Taylor McGarry, Konstantin Startsev, Lucas Vasconcelos Santana, Elina Lobanova, Leandro Martelli, Karl O'Dwyer, Michal Grzedzicki, Ignacio Vazquez, Pablo Alcubilla, Ouafa Mouchaouri, Stuart Cannon, Petar Vasic

SEV1 S270115: {Groups} Group posts are being ranked in reverse order - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/view/s/270115/
Presenter: Yan Cui
Champion: Nitin Agarwal
Required attendees: Jaeyoon Jeong
Other attendees: Amedeo Felice Alberio, Yan Lu, Minh Doan, Yingkai Wang, Simon Yao, Iosef Kaver, Sridhar Nanjundeswaran, Alan Alvarez, Kaushik Veeraraghavan

SEV1 S267487: 30B video files deleted from everstore during L3 Backfill breaking playback for 387M videos affecting 889M users - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/view/s/267487/
Presenter: Giridhar Peddabuttaiahgari
Champion: Gurbir Dhulla
Required attendees:
Other attendees: Yikang Xu, Siddu Duddikunta, Tejas Kudrimoti, Sameet Sapra, Lakshmi Narayanan Srinivasan, Simha Venkataramaiah, Mathieu Henaire, Bradley Bushell, Jeffrey Mickey

SEV1 S271516: IG /api/v1/users/lookup/ is leaking logged out obfuscated email/phone and linked FB account. Millions of daily automated requests - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/view/s/271516/
Presenter: Yi Liu
Champion: Will Camp
Required attendees: Kyle Mix
Other attendees: Ride Bu, Taylor McGarry, Brittainy Lovett, Antonio Ramos, Angelica Escareno, Tyler Richard, Ajit Datar, Gregory Mullen

Details

  *   Zoom ID with passcode for MSR
  *   <https://fb.zoom.us/j/760201844> https://fb.zoom.us/j/760201844
  *   Meeting ID: 760 201 844
  *   Password: 089271
  *   Remote SEV review etiquette post: <https://fb.workplace.com/groups/sevreview/permalink/3424430447605546/> https://fb.workplace.com/groups/sevreview/permalink/3424430447605546/
  *   Discussion group: <https://fb.workplace.com/groups/2505863742998491> https://fb.workplace.com/groups/2505863742998491

HOW TO PREPARE FOR SEV REVIEW: <https://fburl.com/sevreviewprep> https://fburl.com/sevreviewprep

---

COMMON QUESTIONS WE ASK & ADDRESS DURING SEV REVIEW

  *   How many people were affected and have we done everything we can to recover from this specific issue?
  *   Was the recovery completed sufficiently? Did we have the right logging to recover from this? If not, do we now have that logging in place?
  *   Is there a systematic fix we can do to prevent similar issues?
  *   Are the APIs/Interfaces/Alarms/Dashboards clear?
  *   Is the underlying data model robust?
  *   Were there any errors/warnings/failures that were ignored?
  *   Is this part of a bigger theme that needs to get addressed?
  *   Do we have tests in place for this? (If so, why did we not catch it earlier)
  *   Was the detection->fix process smooth & efficient?

If you have scheduling constraints or requests, please let me know ASAP. Do not forward this invite, email punnac@fb.com to include others on the invite.

Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns.

Thank you,
Punna Chalasani

Summary: Prioritize Followup Backlog
A continuation of our series on managing our followups.

We have the untriaged backlog in good shape and we can stay on top of that in weekly oncall review meetings I think.

Now we need to actually do something about this triaged backlog :).

We'll start by prioritizing the small and medium SEV followup tasks which we might be able to make progress on with oncall time:

https://fburl.com/tasks/2avhggj6

The goal will be to ensure that we've correctly identified the high priority work so that we can surface that to oncalls as good candidates to take care of if oncall load is light.

Summary: Investigating Workflow Errors
Everyone is optional - if you can't make it, feel free to put half an hour on my schedule to chat about this!

As part of the oncall health efforts to improve the workflow error usefulness, I made a dashboard that I've found useful in quickly diagnosing workflow error alerts.  Setting up some time to walk through the dashboard, how to get to it when a workflow alert

happens, (why you might want to just keep it open while oncall and check every so often), and the scuba queries and unidash wiring backing it (so that anyone can improve it!)

<https://fburl.com/unidash/64dd6hd5>https://fburl.com/unidash/64dd6hd5

Summary: PSC Reminder: Submit Self/Peer/Upward Feedback – Deadline is Thursday, Jan 13 at 5pm PT 
Submit your self, peer, and upward feedback today, January 13, in the Performance tool<https://our.intern.facebook.com/intern/performance/> by 5pm PT. See below for additional details, resources, and where to go for support.

  *   After 5pm PT, feedback can still be submitted but will have a late stamp, and the feedback may not be reviewed by the manager in time for them to prepare
  *   You can reopen feedback until the 5pm PT deadline if you need to make any edits by going to your Home page > Feedback section > Feedback to Write > Submitted > Reopen.
  *   Shared peer feedback will be available to read on January 14 at 12:01am PT.

Learn More

  *   Tips & examples for PSC feedback<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/people/portal/career/psc/psc-feedback-tips-and-examples>
  *   Details on each step of PSC<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/people/portal/career/psc>
  *   PSC Participation<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/people/portal/career/psc/psc-participation-eligibility>
  *   What it means to be a loop owner and how to

Get Support

There are several ways to get help and provide feedback. See below for what’s right for your scenario.

  *   Performance tool support: Fill out this form<https://fburl.com/psc-bugnub> for a bug report (e.g., UI/Content, broken functionality, you’re not seeing something
  *   Ask the People Team: If you can’t find your answer on the People Portal<https://our.internmc.facebook.com/intern/people/portal/career/psc> or the top FAQs<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/people/portal/help/case-intake/performance/psc>, you can open a case here<https://fburl.com/open-case> for support.
  *   Performance Feedback (PSC Tool & Cycle) group: If you’re still stuck, you can ask your question here<https://fb.workplace.com/groups/PerformanceFeedback/?epa=SEARCH_BOX>. Write feedback about the program or Performance tool this form<https://www.internalfb.com/butterfly/form/226176915672341>, or vote Papercuts<https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Ffburl.com%2Fpapercuts%2F5mkj4h6g&h=AT1A0kZQxbY6wcxDh8CHgMev7Kj_OtnsIryTl9E6Dkt-cVvb37pJXor9SFpLmsoUi4-bE3YkA9pc3VUdoYB8em_y_cgpRFu62CBJziNW6SbCgQ1N3US_1hTkmIq7Yifkm2baEtc>.

Please note that Short-term employees (STEs), interns and contingent workers are not eligible for PSC. See more here<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/people/portal/career/psc/psc-participation-eligibility> .

Summary: Managing Inclusion for Infra ICs (IC6+) - Managing Inclusion for Infra Senior ICs
Managing Inclusion for Infra ICs (IC6+) - Managing Inclusion for Infra Senior ICs

THIS EVENT IS VIRTUAL AND HOSTED ON WEBEX MC - please see additional information below.

Managing Inclusion for Infra Senior ICs (virtual) is an interactive, 3-hour facilitated learning experience that builds your capabilities to create inclusion for every member of your team. As a Senior IC and/or Tech Lead people manager, you play a critical role in creating inclusive team environments and culture at Facebook. Managing Inclusion for Infra Senior ICs (virtual) builds your capabilities to Lead Through and build inclusion for every member of your team at Facebook.

Learning outcomes/skills development:

  *   Learn about diversity, inclusion, and non-ideal strategies that team members—particularly those from underrepresented groups—rely on to try and feel more valued and create a sense of belonging

  *   Examine how diversity dimensions, life experiences, and implicit bias impact the ways you make decisions and interact with team members - and learn ways to amplify positive impact

  *   Engage in interactive exploration and conversations leveraging relevant Infra-specific examples

  *   Take away tangible and actionable tools and action plans to take back to your teams

Prior to attending, please complete Managing Bias<https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Ffburl.com%2Fmanagingbias&h=AT0J5LMAD37v9Mtp0jNP5dA9iW6B9wUFiJV6ZjPKnpZfrNR9lOebQVIZ_RDi3KnlCiRZmSIQtYWOOZK32MymuUYFYk5rWrY9XF65XttergOIm8c3_GGrmk4eb3SAALQST7PLf4mGsMxNxVguxuk>, a required elearn for managers. We also recommend enrolling in a Be the Ally (virtual)<https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Ffburl.com%2Fbetheallyvirtual&h=AT0RuKF3CG58V8qoSqFAF7IAw0b9c8O8iXKn-D4T2NOmF2OKl2x-uoJaOghFmYT1m1bXWNK1iU_nTISEm6EZMB0g_KB4NYLxx-vHo4xBQwFvmmk_eITewfLFhL0GcB5sEOjtOA> session, if you have not already done so.

Accessibility Guidance:

It’s important to us that we build inclusive learning experiences.

If you require an alternative format or other reasonable accommodation during the program to facilitate a better learning experience, please contact accommodations@fb.com<mailto:accommodations@fb.com>.

If you are encountering technical platform difficulties (e.g., program not loading, freezing, or not allowing completion), please contact learning@fb.com<mailto:learning@fb.com> or the in-session support.



To launch the virtual session at session start time:

  1.  Click here<https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Ffburl.com%2Fcsodtranscript&h=AT1SXtAML-CllOhNXI-8ltgIMI1cJSNddM68IgtD_BTcGnmdgURIMeUMkKmc0FtNMe2p2GI7MBxfZQbZ7LHqRY96WQ4tav8t_NXhOExZMyliDbVAQ6UVDW0f5eUsVwCPu-f5Rw> to go to your transcript

  2.  Locate the session and click the blue LAUNCH button to access the virtual class

ADDITIONAL VIRTUAL PROGRAM INSTRUCTIONS:

  *   Download and install the Webex Meetings App<https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.webex.com%2Fdownloads.html&h=AT0Xsa552WfQNXT8AAGhD1L5MZDsOCOkGu20eArtGSxXrs99Bf8HCXUggfR7QWC5X6b2Xee5KLihQHctn-3mHD22bCIVb-RP4QO3KbLfjEb9oj237O6CAfxDS23tZZVSKcsfHQ3r7XrBQm7nxX0> for your laptop in advance

  *   Log into the session using your laptop, and use laptop audio

  *   Video devices, such as Portal, are not supported for sessions with breakouts

  *   It's best to be in a private space, or use headphones and a privacy screen

All information shared during this session will be confidential and proprietary.

Waitlist Guidance

We do not recommend adding your name to a session that already has a waitlist of 10+ people. Instead, select a session with available seats.


View session in Cornerstone <https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Ffacebook.csod.com%2Fsamldefault.aspx%3FReturnUrl%3D%2Fui%2Flms-learning-details%2Fapp%2Fevent%2Fdff76dfd-c360-4a1b-9b9e-410b5e67666f&h=AT0cfTmOwiLFyTN5Xprj7cCmAZGSoCVrpiW9AeFazvwUEFkJX4d8i5tFG0TBjiU0dekpHWHDo8KkKcxBRImA7PWSGERLLTd6vskKJlsxAs1ONfFM1AL_qWG5yVTjPJza4l4voQ>

:PROPERTIES:

Attendees: ... Many

Summary: Tech Talk: Cold Storage Disk Health Lifecycle
Cold Storage Tech Talk Series

This is a completely optional event for those that are interested in learning more about Cold Storage.

Welcome to the first in-person tech talks in 2 years! Bring your lunch, we will start around 12:15PM to give you time to grab some food.

As I ramp down on ABE, I'll be performing these tech talks around Cold Storage related topics to help off-board some of my knowledge, and help onboard new members. Feel free to join if you're and want to learn more about cold Storage!

Topics I plan to cover for Cold Storage:

  *   Cold Storage Architecture How well do you know these 12 services? Which are bachelors, and which have tied the knot?Actual - HDD services, how data moves onto T7 HDD disk s, and how we maintain our data.
  *   Disk Health Lifecycle Disks gone wild, an inside look at disks exposed, and what happens when they can't stay rowdy enough.Actual - How do disks change states and trigger repairs.
  *   Capacity Explained Is capacity even real, or just a figment of our imagination? 1 in every 1 professional thinks capacity is a myth sold by big Corpa.Actual - What HDD capacity is, how we categorize it, and how we handle new & expired drives.

Summary: ABE Oncall Review
Moving this week's review for PSC. Don't worry about trying to make it if the time slot does not work for you.

(replacement series because many people had conflicts with the old on. Sorry for the churn.) !! If you were oncall in the last 2 shifts, fill out your Shift Summary before the review.

Each week we will come together to review the previous 2 oncall shifts. We will treat this like a less formal SEV review using the Oncall Shift Summaries:

  *   We will give everyone 3-5 minutes to read both shift summaries.
  *   The rest of the time is for everyone to ask questions, review the actions, and discuss follow-ups
  *   Tag oncall follow action items with: #abe-oncall-followup

We will end the meeting early when there are no more topics to be discussed.

Oncall Resources:

  *   Oncall Wiki<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/wiki/Archival/Pods/Archival_Backend_Pod/Oncall/>
  *   Shift Summaries<https://www.internalfb.com/intern/monitor/shift_summary_v2?oncall=archival_back_end>
  *   ABE Oncall Health Dashboard<https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Ffburl.com%2Funidash%2Fgcr75y76&h=AT3Ie8KtqnqupNic-1xxg1EVR2V3LKt91fBrFDqPpE0a-QNiohl0SWlIfjU0ERzid6xXHumOh6zOSTHcCwDujlTws6I4eemO6vEu5u9JEzj9oSHP2TWvfhatvv0xQSj6DA8PMoPT>

Summary: ABE-HDD/Isilon Oncall Review
!! If you were oncall in the last shift, fill out your Shift Summary before the review.

Please use the Hands Tool to ask questions: <https://www.internalfb.com/intern/hands?id=95647027658> https://www.internalfb.com/intern/hands?id=95647027658

Each week we will come together to review the previous 2 oncall shifts. We will treat this like a less formal SEV review using the Oncall Shift Summaries:

  *   We will give everyone 3-5 minutes to read both shift summaries.
  *   The rest of the time is for everyone to ask questions, review the actions, and discuss follow-ups
  *   Tag oncall follow action items with: #archival_hdd_oncall_followup

We will end the meeting early when there are no more topics to be discussed.

<2022-03-29 Tue 12:00-13:00> s: 2022-03-29 Tue 12:00 e: 2022-03-29 Tue 13:00 Δ: 1h0m0s
Attendees: ... Many

Summary: Tech Talk: Cold Storage Disk Health Lifecycle Cont.
Cold Storage Tech Talk Series

This is a completely optional event for those that are interested in learning more about Cold Storage.

This session is a continuation of our discussion on the disk health lifecycle. We will explore the end of life, and how disk health states impact block repairs.

Bring your lunch, we will start around 12:15PM to give you time to grab some food.

As I ramp down on ABE, I'll be performing these tech talks around Cold Storage related topics to help off-board some of my knowledge, and help onboard new members. Feel free to join if you're and want to learn more about cold Storage!

Topics I plan to cover for Cold Storage:

  *   Cold Storage Architecture How well do you know these 12 services? Which are bachelors, and which have tied the knot?Actual - HDD services, how data moves onto T7 HDD disk s, and how we maintain our data.
  *   Disk Health Lifecycle Disks gone wild, an inside look at disks exposed, and what happens when they can't stay rowdy enough.Actual - How do disks change states and trigger repairs.
  *   Capacity Explained Is capacity even real, or just a figment of our imagination? 1 in every 1 professional thinks capacity is a myth sold by big Corpa.Actual - What HDD capacity is, how we categorize it, and how we handle new & expired drives.

Summary: Archival Tape Q3 planning - sizing & selection
After the previous discussion of big-picture Q3 priorities, the next step is to estimate sizes and see what work we can take on in Q3. Here's how we'll do this:

  *   Items from the framing doc<https://docs.google.com/document/d/1d7IbipzcrU-sRnF_klS72Z7GLxUxOiQBt8OSONxecao/edit#> are into the OKR tool here: <https://fburl.com/okr/u09xwvnr> https://fburl.com/okr/u09xwvnr
  *   In advance of the meeting, let's fill in size estimates. Each Objective or Key Result has an Owner assigned to it - I'd ask that person to fill in information to size it. If it's an objective (bold text), add one or more Key Results underneath. Then, fill in the "Size" column of each KR (not-bold text) with the estimated number of person-weeks of effort. Optionally, add a short entry to the Description column, possibly linking to some other doc.
     *   To add a Key Result, using three dots under "Actions" column or the + sign that appears when you hover on the left edge. It's ok to just create one Key Result encompassing the whole Objective.
     *   The number of person-weeks is how much of the 60% of time that we plan (7-8 weeks per person in Q3) would be needed for this work. It's not calendar time.
     *   If the estimate is over 8 weeks, either fill in "9" or add a tag like `size:12` to the underlying task.
  *   In this meeting, we'll go over the list. The goal is to mark items we won't do in Q3 with status "ICEBOX", and identify items with P0 priority, and fill in priorities.

Summary: Meta Connect 2022


Join us for Meta Connect 2022 on October 11th, where Mark Zuckerberg and other leaders will talk about how the metaverse is being built by many and why collaboration is the key to it all.


Our annual conference, Meta Connect brings together AR/VR developers, content creators, marketers, and more to celebrate the industry’s momentum and growth. This is a can’t-miss event for not only our external partners, but also employees as we dive deeper into our progress and long-term vision to help build the metaverse.


This year we’ll learn from experts and innovators about their collective visions for the metaverse and discover how AR/VR is evolving to create more connected worlds.

We will follow up with a detailed agenda as we get closer to the date. For more information please follow Meta Connect FYI.<https://fb.workplace.com/groups/connectfyi>

Summary: Follow up library availability SLO

Rescheduling to have this meeting sooner. I find a slot which works bets for most. I would appreciate if we make it work, if not, please let me know and I will reschedule this.

----

Hi All,

The objective of the meeting is to go over details which contributes library SLO. I assume that we have tapes failures, head nodes failures, robotic-arm failures, power failures etc and repair time duration. Review them together and determine if we can improve parts of the system with reasonable ROI.

Pre read doc containing context on how the current SLOs are arrived, context in the current state of affairs in terms of attainment and the SiteOps action plan

<https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BlOcPuXrdHodaOEBcewp7X7yfC6nZpmwvGidk2JwW8I/edit#heading=h.33yqx555za6t>https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BlOcPuXrdHodaOEBcewp7X7yfC6nZpmwvGidk2JwW8I/edit#heading=h.33yqx555za6t

More Context from sev incident report<https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ik2CKb7q-w8Xxdxn3WfDRH9ETCFIk4bA8Yicix7pVb0/edit#>

~11% of libraries were down at one point of time during the event and that was within the TP SLO,

SLO seems pessimistic. Anecdotally slow hardware repairs of tape libraries contributed to longer

down time for libraries.

Follow up:

  1.  Re-evaluate library availability SLO with TP and DC Ops, to expedite library repairs

** Reminder: 2-hour Limited Production Access Storm Test | Saturday 4/23 9-11am PT
:PROPERTIES:
:ID:       A4CEBC8B-AFA7-4B11-96D9-7A1D471748A2

<2022-04-23 Sat 09:00-11:00> s: 2022-04-23 Sat 09:00 e: 2022-04-23 Sat 11:00 Δ: 2h0m0s
Attendees:
   [[mailto:mailto:jmickey@fb.com]["Jeffrey Mickey"]]

Summary: Reminder: 2-hour Limited Production Access Storm Test | Saturday 4/23 9-11am PT
As part of our routine and ongoing work to ensure the security, reliability and availability of our production systems, on Saturday, April 23 starting at 9 AM PT we are running a 2-hour Limited Production Access (LPA) storm test across our production systems. The LPA storm test is part of our routine and ongoing work to ensure the security, reliability and availability of our production systems. We are conducting the test over the weekend to minimize the disruption to your work. We also want to provide you with advance notice so you can plan accordingly.



Please review the guidance below if you plan on working during the hours of this test on Saturday, April 23 at 9:00-11:00 AM PT.



Which services will be disrupted?

If you have a service that connects from the production side to anything on the IT/EE side, it will be interrupted. Additionally, no access into production (i.e., Meta’s code, development environments, and production tools) will work during the test. The LPA test will remove all access to intern (and the tools hosted on it including the People Portal, Tasks and the Wiki), VPN and DevServers / OnDemand.


Which services will continue to work?

A number of our communication and collaboration tools will remain available, including email, Office 365, Google Suite (Docs, Drive, Forms, Sheets, and Slides), Quip, Mattermost<https://fb.workplace.com/groups/ee.fyi/posts/5166544756724493>, Workrooms, Workplace, and Workplace Chat. Review tools such as SRT, cases, etc. will remain available for community operations. We do not expect our public products to be impacted by this test.


What action do you need to take?

  *   Since this will take place on a weekend, most of the company will not be directly impacted. However, if you do need access to these tools, please wait until after the test. If you believe you have a mission critical workflow that can’t wait and needs to be escalated, please contact your VP. Your VP will determine if your request needs to be escalated through the proper channels.
  *   Site IMOCs and CMOCs (Engineering on-call) will be monitoring the stability of the site and will involve engineering teams as needed for any urgent issue.
  *   If you have any questions or troubleshooting leading up to and during the test, we will be monitoring comments on the All FYI post HERE<https://fb.workplace.com/groups/fyi/permalink/5227279653995819/>.
  *   During the test, please check the All FYI post for live updates and confirmation of the completion of the test.

Summary: Triage/Estimate SEV and Oncall followups
For potential inclusion in Q3 planned work, let's look at the backlog of SEV followup items and oncall followup items. (SEV followups: https://www.internalfb.com/omh/view/ice_palace/tasks?query=307898680756453; Oncall followups: https://www.internalfb.com/omh/view/ice_palace/tasks?query=1907567886086109).


For the ones we agree are important, we'll ensure they have priority set right relative to the others and then do a very brief costing exercise and add them to the list of things to consider for Ice Palace in Q3.


I'm going to propose we follow a similar process to HDD where for each item we ask if we should not do it (in which case we'll close it), bootcamp it (in which case we'll make it medium or low priority and tag it bootcampable), or if we should consider it for our planning.


For work we want to consider, we need a rough estimate.  We'll do this quickly for each item and classify it as small, medium, or large.  I suggest we use 1-2 days as Small, 1-2 weeks as Medium, and 1 month of more as Large.  And we'll round up (if we think it is between small and medium, we'll call it medium).

Summary: Tape SEV and Oncall followup triage
Continuing SEV and Oncall followup Triage.

Goal is to get through SEV followups and as much of oncall followups are we can.

For each item, we'll close it if we don't plan to do it at all, tag it bootcampable if we can do it with bootcamp resources, or tag it as triaged and set a size (S = 1-2 days, M = 1-2 weeks, L = 1 month or more... round up) if we should consider it for Q3 planning.

I've done some de-duplication and gotten us a query that filters out triaged work. Updated titles on SEV followups so they sort together by title so we can start with them:

https://fburl.com/tasks/tld4v4yr

Tasks we've triaged so far and should consider for Q3 are here:

https://fburl.com/tasks/s9f2hsje

All bootcampable tasks or tasks with a significant potentially bootcampable element are here (and we should consider budgetting some time in Q3 to get some of these into bootcamp):

https://fburl.com/tasks/f52ov91k

Attendees: ... Many

Summary: Tech Talk: Cold Storage T7 Hardware Overview
Cold Storage Tech Talk Series

This is a completely optional event for those that are interested in learning more about Cold Storage.

This session will bring in a physical storage chassis so that we can see what makes a T7 and how it relates to Cold Storage software.

I highly recommend attending this talk in person. We will record and I will share images of a T7 so that you can follow along remotely, but this does not make up for seeing and interacting with part of a node in person.

Bring your lunch, we will start around 12:15PM to give you time to grab some food.

As I ramp down on ABE, I'll be performing these tech talks around Cold Storage related topics to help off-board some of my knowledge, and help onboard new members. Feel free to join if you're and want to learn more about cold Storage!

Topics I plan to cover for Cold Storage:

  *   Cold Storage Architecture How well do you know these 12 services? Which are bachelors, and which have tied the knot?Actual - HDD services, how data moves onto T7 HDD disk s, and how we maintain our data.
  *   Disk Health Lifecycle Disks gone wild, an inside look at disks exposed, and what happens when they can't stay rowdy enough.Actual - How do disks change states and trigger repairs.
  *   Capacity Explained Is capacity even real, or just a figment of our imagination? 1 in every 1 professional thinks capacity is a myth sold by big Corpa.Actual - What HDD capacity is, how we categorize it, and how we handle new & expired drives.

________________________________

Summary: Tape Platform Sync Meeting
UPDATE:

Now that we're getting closer to PVT exit, Pilot and MP, it makes sense for us to start Tape Platform oncall reviews.

Let's try to do it at the end of these sync meetings. We'll see if it works or not and then decide if we need a separate review meeting.

ASK:

Oncall for the previous week please come prepared with an oncall report/post and a list of topics/things to discuss during the review.

Agenda & notes quip:

<https://fb.quip.com/P6JJAnvaySOH>https://fb.quip.com/P6JJAnvaySOH

Hi all,

I'm setting up some time for us to meet periodically to discuss and coordinate things related to tape platform: e.g. tasks, projects, blockers, decisions.

We'll change the scope, agenda, format, duration, frequency of the meeting as we go to make it as useful as possible.

Please let me know if this day/time is not working for you.

Thanks,

Dmitry

Summary: Jeffrey | Mayank
Hey Jeffrey,

Hope you are doing well! I am setting up this 1:1 to introduce myself, learn the context of the challenges that archival services are facing as well as share some context on the challenges that IDC are facing with respect to execution of operations in archival buildings. I will also share some context on what expectations we have built with IDC for non archival buildings and how it has helped services to evolve independently from datacenter design. I am interested in hearing your feedback on how I can help.

Hey folks,

Setting up team meeting series for Tape pod every 2 weeks that interleaves with our biweekly planning syncs. The intent of this meeting is to have a separate forum for discussion of topics outside of execution/oncall syncs and a forcing function for us to get together especially as we have a good mix of BEL/MPK/Remote folks.

This will be an agenda driven<https://docs.google.com/document/d/11O15HmgAqBLJA4NpzrHgdroz7uD-TE9Zd5mejufb6pY/edit>.

Thanks

-Karthik

Summary: {May 05, 2022} Storage SEV Review
Hello, you are invited to SEV Review to discuss the following SEVs

Agenda - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/review/294885629384722/

SEV1 S266530: Warm Storage Client Rate Limiter Bug {fix landed} - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/view/s/266530/
Presenter: Albert Kim
Champion: Sai Bathina
Required attendees: George Puthanpurackal, Vineet Badhwar
Other attendees: Vishnu Pydah, Jennifer Chan (Infra), Paul Paradise

SEV3 S265925: WSCK was unable to scan WS data stores due ClientRateLimiter changes - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/view/s/265925/
Presenter: Vishnu Pydah
Champion: Atul Sikaria
Required attendees:
Other attendees: Pai-Chun Wang, Albert Kim, Vishnu Pydah, Vincent Acunia, George Puthanpurackal, Paul Paradise

SEV3 S268519: WS security config changes took down preprod cluster - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/view/s/268519/
Presenter: Chirag Pandya (Storage)
Champion: Surabhi Pandey
Required attendees:
Other attendees: Jason Rahman, Paul Paradise

SEV3 S266501: Intermittent errors writing Manifold bucket backups - https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/view/s/266501/
Presenter: Norm Morrison
Champion: Elle Lin
Required attendees:
Other attendees: Maxim Patlasov, Daniel Munoz, Piyush Mukati, Paul Paradise

Details

Agenda:
<https://fburl.com/storage_sev_review_agenda>https://fburl.com/storage_sev_review_agenda

Zoom Meeting: <https://fb.zoom.us/j/95647027658?pwd=NXphY1RJa3BQdGRCL0t5TFZUcHNQZz09> https://fb.zoom.us/j/95647027658?pwd=NXphY1RJa3BQdGRCL0t5TFZUcHNQZz09

Meeting ID: 956 4702 7658
Passcode: 771773

  *   How to ask a question: the Workplace group Storage SEV Review Discussion<https://fburl.com/storagesevreview> will have a post for each SEV. Comment on the post for the SEV currently being discussed with your question. The moderator will then call on you to ask your question and the presenter will respond along with any discussion around it.

Read more about Storage SEV Review: <https://www.internalfb.com/intern/wiki/Storage_Team/SEV_Review/> https://www.internalfb.com/intern/wiki/Storage_Team/SEV_Review/

Storage SEV review uses a reading format – 2-4 minutes to read each incident report before discussions.
Only the team presenting and the moderator should speak, unless called on.
If you are not the moderator or the presenting team, please raise your hand using Hands:

To add this review to your calendar: click on a SEV being presented and click the "Subscribe to this SEV's review(s)" button.
To add all Storage SEV reviews to your calendar: click "Subscribe" on Storage SEV review listed on <https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/review/series/> https://www.internalfb.com/intern/sevmanager/review/series/
To add yourself to the recurring meeting series (to block off your calendar proactively): <https://fburl.com/meeting/r08fc3s6> https://fburl.com/meeting/r08fc3s6

If you have scheduling constraints or requests, please let me know ASAP. Do not forward this invite, email ashleychickvary@fb.com to include others on the invite.

Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns.

Thank you,
Ashley Chickvary

Summary: Storage All-hands and Q&A
How to Participate:

,**UPDATE I have reserved rooms in Bel and MPK for those of you in the office to watch together**

This session will be completely virtual and broadcasted via. Livestream to Storage Core.

(Important: Please be sure to restart your VPN connection prior to joining the livestream. This will help ensure a seamless audio/visual experience.)

How to Submit a Question for the Q&A

,*Pre-Event *

To submit your question in advance, please add it to the poll in Storage Core

We will ask the top voted questions from the poll and then take questions during the live stream.

,*During Event *

Once the Q&A kicks off, you can ask your question by posting it directly within the comments section on the live stream. We will do our best to answer as many of these in real-time as possible.

Video Replay

If you are unable us to join us live, a video of the Q&A will be accessible for later viewing/playback within Storage Core.
